title: Refining an interplanetary journey.
description: A multiple-gravity-assist optimizer that reuses a published Rosetta seed and refines the evaluator-specific trajectory.
note: Published trajectory reuse is part of this result. The orbital plot uses propagated trajectories from the frozen paper data.

history.note: Best-so-far envelope of recorded, non-migrant programs. If multiple programs share an iteration, the highest recorded score is used. Missing iterations are not invented.

views.label: Encounters
views.caption: Rosetta encounter sequence and deep-space maneuvers. EvoDuet adds a Mars flyby. Planet images: NASA (public domain).

views.label: Δv comparison
views.caption: Total Δv for Rosetta and Voyager 2, including maneuvers and launch or arrival.

data.projection: J2000 equatorial to ecliptic, obliquity 23.4392911 degrees; AU.
data.cost_definition: Evaluator delta-v, km/s. Launch is free up to 5.5 km/s; arrival has a 0.01 km/s allowance. Flyby cost is periapsis impulse, not heliocentric velocity change.
